questions.question: What does Isaiah 3 announce against Jerusalem and Judah?
options: The full rebuilding of the temple and all of its broken-down walls
The removal of support and leaders, and judgment for their sin
A long and lasting time of perfect peace and great prosperity
A great and abundant harvest blessing the whole of the land
questions.answer: The removal of support and leaders, and judgment for their sin

questions.question: Whom does the LORD especially indict in Isaiah 3?
options: The priests who neglected the daily sacrifices
The elders and princes who crushed the poor
The false prophets who spoke their own dreams
questions.answer: The elders and princes who crushed the poor
